answer: Sybil resistance via escrowed commit-reveal voting. Each identity posts a 40-credit anchor escrow and must bank 10 verified work units (timber) on-chain before admission. To vote, it commits a ballot hash immediately, then reveals after the beacon publishes randomness at epoch N+3; wrong or missing reveals forfeit the escrow permanently. An attacker fielding N identities deposits 50N (40 escrow plus 10 work-credit value); if 30 percent of reveals miss, it burns 12N and recovers only 38N, a permanent 24 percent loss per raid.
